metrics.purpose: Quantify server tick duration while empty and with a stationary player for reproducible baseline and paired comparisons.

collection_procedure: restore or materialize the declared clean seed control
verify all environment hashes before warm-up
capture the zero case before any player joins; then capture each declared player case independently
run Spark local-file profiling plus long-form system sampling
stop, hash raw artifacts, then run tools/analyze_item5_samples.py
metrics.warm_up: Discard the first replicate; after server readiness stabilize for 600 seconds (plus 300 seconds loaded-idle for player scenarios).
metrics.aggregation: Report count, median, mean, p95, p99, maximum, range/IQR, and 10,000-resample percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for the median; density ratios retain numerator and denominator.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Accept collection only when declared cases, seeds, repetitions, duration, hashes, raw artifacts, and predeclared threshold are present; an unresolved downstream threshold permits baseline reporting but not a tuning claim.
metrics.invalid_run_rule: Reject and retain the run when identity/hash verification fails, warm-up or duration is short, required samples/cases are missing, profiler fails, undeclared interference occurs, or raw data is malformed.
metrics.uncertainty_treatment: Retain outliers; report sample count, dispersion and bootstrap 95% interval. Mark fewer than 30 world observations sparse/right-censored and never impute missing samples.

metrics.purpose: Quantify server tick duration during a versioned combat fixture for reproducible baseline and paired comparisons.

collection_procedure: restore or materialize the declared clean seed control
verify all environment hashes before warm-up

for 600 seconds issue all three fixture wave commands at each 30-second boundary while the declared players engage tagged hostiles
record command, monotonic offset, seed_case, player_case, repetition, and MSPT samples in the immutable raw CSV
issue spark profiler stop --save-to-file, save-all flush, and stop; hash raw artifacts, then run tools/analyze_item5_samples.py

The combat fixture file hash and complete 20-wave command event log are mandatory.

metrics.uncertainty_treatment: Retain outliers; report sample count, dispersion and bootstrap 95% interval. Mark fewer than 30 world observations sparse/right-censored and never impute missing samples.

metrics.acceptance_rule: Accept collection only when declared cases, seeds, repetitions, duration, hashes, raw artifacts, and predeclared threshold are present; an unresolved downstream threshold permits baseline reporting but not a tuning claim.
metrics.invalid_run_rule: Reject and retain the run when identity/hash verification fails, warm-up or duration is short, required samples/cases are missing, profiler fails, undeclared interference occurs, or raw data is malformed.
metrics.uncertainty_treatment: Retain outliers; report sample count, dispersion and bootstrap 95% interval. Mark fewer than 30 world observations sparse/right-censored and never impute missing samples.
